findings.evidence: scripts/audit-triage-merge.py:17 json.loads can raise; operator triage script, accepted fail-loud risk.
findings.message: scripts/audit-triage-merge.py:17 — Unhandled JSON decode error. Who is hurt: Operators running batch merges. Failure: A single corrupted result-batch file aborts the entire merge with an unhandled JSONDecodeError.

findings.evidence: --export-history intentionally writes only 6-defer-resolved.json for the defer-resolution step, not a full bucket export.

findings.evidence: scripts/audit-triage-merge.py:44-45 read ledger/results without exists check; diagnostic script, not product path.

findings.evidence: scripts/audit-triage-create-issues.py:174-175 takes the URL tail without isdigit(); operator triage helper, not product path.
findings.message: scripts/audit-triage-create-issues.py:145 — Missing issue ID validation. Who is hurt: Downstream automation reading issue manifests. Failure: Extracted URL tail is not validated as numeric, allowing non-issue strings into issue-ids json.

findings.evidence: Markdown finding_id() hashes path/line/message; self-labels keep lab IDs by design. Ghostreader ingest defaults to markdown-only.
findings.message: scripts/audit-triage-ingest.py:52 — ID Inconsistency. Who is hurt: Triage tracking and deduplication workflows. Failure: Markdown-parsed findings receive different IDs than identical findings loaded from self-labels.json, breaking lookups and state correlation.

findings.evidence: FINDING_RE at line 23 (cite ~20) skips non-matching lines; accepted ingest contract for known audit markdown shape.
findings.message: scripts/audit-triage-ingest.py:20 — Strict pattern matching. Who is hurt: Security engineers triaging audit outputs. Failure: Findings with non-standard formatting fail FINDING_RE and are dropped silently without logging.

findings.evidence: L85 formats findings; _collect_all_findings aggregates agents without dedup by design.
findings.message: ghostreader/agents/synthesis.py:85 — Finding deduplication missing. Who is hurt: Final report readers. Failure: Strengths and concerns count inflate duplicate findings across multiple agent outputs.

findings.evidence: CLI report clock / generatedAt — accepted operational non-determinism
findings.message: scripts/audit-triage-ingest.py:345 — Non-deterministic fallback. Who is hurt: Automation expecting reproducible audit records. Failure: Audit commit defaults to 'unknown' when git commands fail, obscuring source revision context in outputs.

findings.evidence: _extract_xhtml_title prefers first title then h1/h2; heuristic nav misfires are accepted EPUB risk, not a clear defect.
findings.message: ghostreader/ingestion/epub_loader.py:102 — Unstable chapter title selection. Who is hurt: readers relying on chapter headings. Failure: first <title> or <h1>/<h2> tag in iteration order may match nav menus or boilerplate rather than actual chapter titles.

findings.evidence: default export_id is YYYY-MM-DD-ghostreader at L68; --id override exists; same-id overwrite is accepted CLI default
findings.message: scripts/audit-triage-export-buckets.py:70 — ID collision. Who is hurt: Operators running multiple exports on the same day. Failure: Default export ID based only on date causes subsequent runs to silently overwrite previous exports.

findings.evidence: compute_verdict L55-63 returns ship when no concern severities; empty lists mean clean, not unanalyzed.
findings.message: ghostreader/companion/brief.py:46 — False ship verdict on empty findings. Who is hurt: Pipeline operators gating chapter publication. Failure: An unanalyzed or skipped chapter with empty finding lists is granted a green ship verdict.

findings.evidence: ensure_facts L180 gather fails fast on LLM error; no partial overwrite/KeyError path without return_exceptions.
findings.message: ghostreader/companion/fact_memory.py:186 — Unhandled exception during fact extraction. Who is hurt: FactMemoryStore callers. Failure: Unhandled LLM failure aborts entire gather without recovery, and duplicate chapter numbers overwrite facts or cause KeyErrors.

findings.evidence: progress.py:130-137 intentionally uses max so rewrites do not lower last_chapter_companioned; docstring states that contract.
findings.message: ghostreader/companion/progress.py:132 — Erroneous progress cursor advancement. Who is hurt: Callers analyzing chapters non-sequentially. Failure: Setting last_chapter_companioned to max suppresses subsequent skip/gap warnings, masking unanalyzed earlier chapters.

findings.evidence: Filename chapter-NNN numbering is intentional for companion/analyze paths; loader never reads chapter numbers from headings.
findings.message: ghostreader/ingestion/markdown_loader.py:70 — Filename vs content chapter number discrepancy. Who is hurt: users indexing markdown chapters. Failure: _chapter_number_from_filename overrides internal heading numbering, causing mismatched chapter metadata when filenames diverge.

findings.message: scripts/audit-triage-create-issues.py:74 — Uncaught decoding exception. Who is hurt: Users providing non-UTF-8 note files. Failure: read_text(encoding='utf-8') raises unhandled UnicodeDecodeError and terminates execution.

findings.message: ghostreader/agents/fact_extractor.py:93 — Uncaught task exceptions. Who is hurt: Fact extraction consumers. Failure: asyncio.gather does not catch or handle individual chapter task failures, potentially failing the entire batch or dropping facts.

findings.message: scripts/audit-triage-export-buckets.py:100 — Unsorted JSON output. Who is hurt: Automated CI diffing across runs. Failure: json.dumps without sort_keys=True can produce non-deterministic key order, resulting in spurious git diffs.
